record.name: Force Pull
record.narrative: You bend space and physics to your will, granting move creatures and objects to different positions through sheer force. The power manifests as enhanced momentum, fluid motion, creating a moment of liberating freedom.
record.flavor_text: The Force will be with you, always.

manifestation.description: clear, forceful gesture extending telekinetic energy
visualizing the desired effect and channeling Force energy

base_effect.description: You use the Force to pull a creature or object toward you.

mechanics.notes: Target is pulled 10 feet toward you

class_synergies.narrative: Guardian approaches Force Pull through the lens of protection, finding unexpected harmony in the drawing targets with irresistible telekinetic force. Their defensive combat and protection of others guides them to vibrating air with a focused resolve that reflects their unique perspective.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Guardians gain +1 to Force power attack rolls.

species_synergies.narrative: Human adaptability allows them to quickly master new powers.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Humans gain advantage on power learning checks.

faction_synergies.narrative: The Jedi Order teaches the proper use of Force powers.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Jedi gain +2 to Force power saving throw DCs.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Describe the enhanced movement capabilities. Focus on how the power's effects manifest physically and mechanically, emphasizing provide movement abilities.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Force Pull is excellent for moving enemies out of position or into hazards. Use it at 30 feet range.
narrative_hooks: Force Pull allows for incredible mobility, reaching places that should be impossible to access
The movement granted by Force Pull creates tactical advantages that surprise everyone

image_generation.base_prompt: A dramatic digital painting of. Force Pull. in action. forcibly moving targets with telekinetic power. with enhanced momentum, fluid motion. The mood is liberating freedom, showing the raw power and intensity of the effect.
